evidence: Conversation lookup, missing-thread hydration recursion, and older-history loading are preserved as a typed readiness policy; no UI initialization side effects are copied.
Cross-realm DOM element detection is isolated as a deterministic predicate; ownerDocument constructors and structural fallbacks are preserved without primary runtime registration.
Absolute browser URL formatting is a pure host/path/query/hash projection with no UI or signal lifecycle dependency.
Site URL matching only compares normalized protocol, port, host aliases, and path boundaries; initialization remains in the hub.
Suggested follow-up payload normalization validates, trims, preserves source indexes, and caps output without primary hub side effects.
Attachment summary formatting combines annotation/design-tweak and comment counts through the supplied formatter; the extracted module has no renderer lifecycle or signal registration.

Tenant-subdomain extraction is a deterministic URL/hostname policy with explicit suffix allowlisting; the hub keeps its compatibility export because no independent renderer import currently owns this boundary.

The absolute-URL predicate is only consumed by the adjacent foreground-image selector tAe; no renderer module imports the public alias, so extracting it would create a facade without a real named consumer.

The URL-scheme classifier is an implementation detail of rA/tAe in the generated hub and has no independent renderer call site; preserve the coupled scope until a named consumer establishes a stable contract.
The /tasks local-action predicate is only called by the adjacent eAe URL projection; no renderer module imports the public alias, so extracting it would create an unowned action-surface facade.

The recipient/cc/bcc display projection is coupled to the adjacent NI/MI validators and RI regex initialization; no renderer module names this aggregate export, so extracting it would create an unowned email-surface facade.

The loading/eligibility status projection is a two-branch local formatter exported only through the generated hub; there is no named renderer consumer or independent lifecycle boundary to own a facade.

The selection/hover rectangle style builder is coupled to the adjacent annotation SVG and selection overlay renderers; its appearance, zoom scaling, and fill-only branches are consumed only inside the generated hub, so extracting it without a named renderer owner would create an unowned styling facade.

The plan-action projection maps workspace ownership and plan tier to the adjacent upgrade/add-credits/notify-owner actions; it is consumed only by the local plan purchase flow and depends on the generated Gm enum, so extracting it without a named renderer owner would create an unowned billing facade.

The predicate checks whether a selected creation target is Git-backed by consulting the project list and project kind. The published alias has no named renderer consumer (only the generated hub scope owns it), so extracting it now would create an unowned project-target facade; preserve the exact line-level implementation until a renderer boundary establishes the target contract.

The pending/unavailable projection is a two-flag local formatter consumed by the adjacent takeover UI assembly and has no named renderer import or independent lifecycle boundary; retain the coupled generated helper rather than creating an unowned status facade.

The default-branch query initializer wires hub-local RPC state and cache registration; its side effects are inseparable from the generated request runtime and there is no independent renderer consumer to own a facade.

The CSS capability predicate detects var() and color-mix() tokens for the adjacent generated color pipeline; it has no independent renderer import or lifecycle boundary, so preserving the coupled helper avoids creating an unowned styling facade.

The slash-command pin surface resolves localized title/description and registers a Pin chat command through the adjacent composer runtime; it is rendered only by the local chat-route branch and has no independent renderer named consumer or lifecycle boundary, so preserving the coupled generated React surface avoids an unowned facade.

The helper projects a selected repository clone URL from generated repo-map state and delegates feature gating to the adjacent cst helper. It has no named renderer consumer or independent repository-query boundary, so retaining the exact generated implementation is safer than introducing an unowned facade.
